scope: Five real Chromium cases for the separately identified native key feature; original restic comparisons belong to the finite job.
names: visible key lifecycle preserves a native snapshot through password replacement, removal and restart
rejected key forms clear secrets and a wrong access password returns the genuine host error
empty-password controls require explicit opt-in and never discard a nonempty secret
a held genuine key-list response blocks another mutation until the active request completes
an unrelated damaged key is warned about and can be removed through visible controls
